tools.name: get_my_courses
tools.description: List the student's active Google Classroom classes with their IDs. Use this when the user asks 'What classes am I in?' or needs a course ID to pass to another tool.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Everything assigned that the student has not turned in yet. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'What do I still have to do?' or 'What's left to turn in across all my classes?'

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Work that is due soon and not turned in, soonest first. Pass course_ids or days_ahead to narrow it, or leave both empty. Use this when the user asks 'What's due this week across all my classes?' or 'What's coming up?'

tools.name: get_missing_assignments
tools.description: Past due work that has not been turned in. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'What's overdue?' or 'What am I behind on?'

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Assignments for one class with due dates and status. Use this when the user asks 'What's due in this class?' or wants every assignment and its points for a single class.

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Grades on returned work for each class. Google Classroom has no overall grade, so this adds up graded work only. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'How am I doing in my classes?' or 'What grades have I gotten back?'

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Recent announcements. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'Did my teacher post anything new?' or 'What did my teacher announce?'

tools.name: get_course_materials
tools.description: Posted materials for one class. Use this when the user asks 'What materials did my teacher post?' or wants the readings, slides and handouts for one class.
